sections.h2: Global upstream spending fell to $420 billion, roughly 30% below need

chart.title: Global upstream capex is roughly 30% below the annual need
chart.sub: Upstream capital expenditure against S&P Global's stated annual need, $ billion.

sections.means: Spending fell for a second year running, leaving about $180 billion a year short of the $600 billion S&P Global says is needed.

sections.h2: Indian Oil, ONGC and Oil India each cut Q1 capex by 16% or more

chart.title: Indian Oil, ONGC and Oil India each cut Q1 capex by 16% or more
chart.source: PPAC provisional figures via Business Standard.

sections.means: The 12-PSU total fell only 3.8%, which hides steeper company-level cuts behind the first Q1 decline in at least five years.
sections.todo: Track the next quarter's PSU capex to test the experts' view that this dip is a one-off.
